svg.title: SiteMorph end-to-end climate-to-design architecture
svg.desc: Autodesk Forma site geometry flows through the embedded SiteMorph client, cache-first server orchestration, FortyGuard historical analysis, deterministic Climate DNA and design decisions, native Forma validation, reporting, and the supported manual Forma-to-Revit handoff. Functional and non-functional requirements are summarized below the flow.

g.text: FortyGuard adds historical thermal context to Forma · deterministic decisions · native geometry · auditable delivery
floor stacks · Sun · Rapid Wind · camera
Local Vite middleware · Worker / Vercel Function adapters
local FS · R2 or private Vercel Blob + ETag CAS
Ordered key fallback only on definitive invalid / revoked / exhausted

svg.text: MEASURED FORMA LOOP · terrain-aligned proposal + native analysis evidence

g.text: • Uniform parcel → site-wide Moderate; no compass claim
Fine variation may come only from readable Forma grids
FG burden × mitigation → 50% of final score
• Only the selected option is materialized
No paid option generation · no runtime GPT / LLM
• Native floor stacks + persistent concept context
roads · paths · greens · upright GLB trees
• Test at most one explainable revision
retain measured improvement; otherwise roll back
Unreadable grid → native-result-only / partial, never fabricated
• JSON / CSV evidence · generic OBJ reference
Proposals → Revit → Send to Revit add-in
• Manual host action; no direct SiteMorph Revit API
Concept roads / trees / lots are not native Revit BIM
Select and validate a real Forma Site Limit AOI.
Restore aggregate/activity cache before any paid submission.
Build Climate DNA with required first-run satellite context.
Render the complete AOI without invented spatial resolution.
Produce deterministic briefs and visible planning assumptions.
Create terrain-aligned native building / selected subdivision.
Validate with native Sun and optional Rapid Wind.
Test no more than one explainable measured revision.
Persist, verify and transactionally roll back geometry.
Expose trace, source labels, IDs and decision formulas.
Export genuine DOCX plus optional evidence sidecars.
Preflight and guide the supported Forma → Revit route.
Deterministic and auditable; no runtime LLM.
Server-only keys, same-origin validation, strict failover.
First uncached max 15; same-AOI reruns create zero.
Durable IDs, cache recovery, in-flight request dedupe.
Fail closed when required satellite imagery is missing.
Bounded polling, retries, concurrency and geometry size.
Preserve FortyGuard resolution and source attribution.
Portable local/worker adapters over shared logic.
Type, build, cache, geometry and hosted test gates.

svg.text: Boundary: preliminary climate-to-design intelligence — not zoning, entitlement, legal, financial, market, fire, civil, structural, planting or permit compliance.
Solid = implemented · dashed = conditional/manual · generated 4K source
